Passport and visa photos at Pacific Fair

Yes, you can get passport and visa photos taken while you wait at Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair in Broadbeach, for $25 with printed and digital copies. We do Australian and overseas formats for ages 5 and over, and it takes about 10 minutes. No appointment is needed; come in any time we’re open.

Call (07) 5592 2099 Hours & directions

How much do passport photos cost?

Passport and visa photos cost $25. Come in any time during our opening hours and we’ll take your photo while you wait.

  • No appointment needed
  • Australian and overseas passport and visa photos
  • Ages 5 and above
  • Printed and digital copies of your photos

Do I need to book for passport photos?

No. Walk in any day we’re open, including until 9pm on Thursdays, and allow about 10 minutes.

Can you do photos for other countries’ passports and visas?

Yes. Applying for another country’s passport or visa? Tell us which one and we’ll set up the right format. For Australian passports, see the full requirements at the Australian Passport Office.

How do I get a photo that’s accepted first time?

  • Neutral expression, with your mouth closed and eyes open.
  • No glasses: Australian passports don’t accept photos with glasses.
  • Face uncovered: hair away from your eyes and no hats. Religious head coverings are fine if your full face is visible.
  • Plain clothing that contrasts with a light background.
  • Recent: photos must be taken within the last six months.

Travelling soon? We can help with that too

See our travel health advice and travel vaccines, or ask our pharmacists about a travel health kit.

Common questions

How much do passport photos cost?

Passport and visa photos are $25, taken and printed while you wait, with digital copies included. Just walk in.

Do I need to book for passport photos?

No. Come in any time we’re open and we’ll take your photos while you wait. It usually takes about 10 minutes.

Can you take photos for overseas passports and visas?

Yes. Tell us which country or visa the photo is for when you come in and we’ll set up the right format and size.

Can you take passport photos for children?

Yes, for children aged 5 and over. For younger children, call us and we’ll let you know what’s possible.

Can I wear glasses in my passport photo?

No. Australian passports don’t accept photos with glasses, so please take them off for the photo. We’ll check the rest of the requirements with you on the day.

Do I get a digital copy?

Yes. You receive printed photos and digital copies, which is handy for online applications. Both are included in the $25.
